title: Mine and escape-tunnel props: cart, track, cage lamp, hose, cables, shovel
summary: Tunnel/mine kit: mine cart on a checker-safe track (rails one mesh, 10 cm tall), caged lamp with light pools, ribbed air hose, sagging cables, dirt piles, planted shovel, floor lantern.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: import { railTrack, mineCart, cageLamp, dirtPile, shovel, plantShovel } from '../library/module.recon.mine-props/index.js';

doc.when: Escape tunnels, mines, excavations, bunkers, construction trenches.
doc.avoid: Thin flat rails (the contact check treats diagonal thin rails as decals: the cart floats) and separate rail meshes at one height (COPLANAR).
gotchas: mineCart y = the rail top (railTrack().railTop): wheel centres sit .17 above the cart origin.
Lamp lights use decay 2 and a 3.5 m range on purpose: pools of light, not a flat orange wash.
The floor lantern's glass is an emissive STANDARD material: the contact check skips MeshBasicMaterial meshes, so a top resting on a basic glow reads as floating.
The shovel is noContact (held); call plantShovel every tick before handTo.

params.railTrack o: x0 x1 y zAt gauge steel wood
params.mineCart o: x y z ry L W gauge load
params.cables o: x0 x1 ref y z period sag colors r
